# Cncf Kubediagrams Reviewer

Review KubeDiagrams using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. KubeDiagrams is a tool to generate Kubernetes architecture diagrams from Kubernetes manifest files, kustomization files, Helm charts, and actual cluster state. KubeDiagrams supports most of all Kubernetes built-in resources, any custom resources, and label-based resource clustering.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
